title: Errors and troubleshooting
body:
Understand the error

The error panel shows the diagnostic and source line where available. Edit this line retrieves it without running anything. Unsupported syntax is never silently translated. RUN compiles the entire program, so an error can refer to a line you have not reached yet.

Message or symptomWhat to do
Expected = / found a keyword inside a nameCheck the selected dialect. Historical profiles reserve embedded keywords; modern full names need the appropriate profile. Preserve reference source.
Unknown session commandNumber program statements. READY accepts environment commands, not immediate expressions.
Unterminated string / numbered source requiredClose quotes; use one numbered logical record per text line. Scanned multiline listings need a documented transcription.
Type mismatch / numeric overflowCheck $/% suffixes, typed defaults, division/domain and numeric INPUT.
Undefined line / RETURN or NEXT without matching call/loopInspect control flow and the target line; use LIST and EDIT.
Out of DATA / array boundsCheck READ count, RESTORE and inclusive DIM bounds.
Wrong device mode / EOF / record mismatchInsert the right tape, rewind for reading, and match each PRINT# record with its INPUT# fields.
Execution/output/memory budget exhaustedFind unbounded loops or excessive output/allocation. RUN starts a new bounded run; CONT cannot bypass limits.
Cannot continueOnly a live STOP is resumable. Editing, settings changes, errors and program end invalidate continuation.
Worker unavailable/stoppedExport editor source, reload in a browser supporting Workers and local Blob scripts. No unsafe main-thread fallback exists.
Import rejectedKeep the original file, check format/version/size and use the correct source/workspace/media import control. Failed validation preserves current data.

Keyboard and accessibility

Tab traverses controls; Enter activates buttons or submits the prompt; Space opens a focused disclosure. Source editing uses native selection/navigation. The latest short LIST exposes line buttons; EDIT works for larger programs. Output is selectable and a labeled scroll region. Status announcements are brief, not a spoken copy of every output line. For extensive output, navigate the transcript manually. Fullscreen/focus view can be exited; there is no deliberate keyboard trap.

Privacy

Source, workspaces and device data remain local. Downloads use local Blob URLs. Importing untrusted BASIC does not grant it host filesystem or network access. Do not put secrets in source intended for sharing. These controls and automated tests are not a formal security certification.
